mission.title: Mysteries Revealed
mission.description: Learn the truth about the vials, then gather Zion's data on Anome.

npc.say: If you meet up with that rat, give him a bullet right between the eyes for me!
Quantum flipped ions... you can't do that! Can you?

phase.briefing:
Recent events require that you be apprised of some background information, {player}. We are on a very high level of alert, and we are indeed concerned for the future of the simulation.
As she is so... fond of dealing with humans, I will have Agent Pace conduct your briefing. You will find her at the indicated location.

enter.say: You get to meet with Pace? And I'm stuck here on the ship? Figures.

talk.say:
Ciao, tesoro! I am so happy to see one of my operatives; if only it could be under better circumstances.
Purtroppo, I must give you some explanation regarding these vials. You see, in a previous version of the Matrix, our Agents were given some... amazing powers to allow them to carry out their jobs. Powers you have never witnessed within the Matrix, I can assure you. Powers that would astound you.
And indeed, powers that would astound anyone, including the bluepills who witnessed them. It soon became apparent that such powers were... I suppose you might say counterproductive. The codes for these powers were put into storage, never to be touched again.
Apparently, we once again underestimated the amount of chaos present in this little system of ours. And so, we have a situation on our hands.

done.say: Tesoro, I trust that you will make me proud, si? We need the best from all of our people, and all of our programs as well, if we are to come out of this without further disaster.

I hope you see now why we are so concerned. Agents of the Machines, using those powers, caused enough problems to warrant the end of the program. Now imagine those same powers in the hands of unpredictable, willful... humans...

phase.briefing: Now you must conduct some data collection. The current location of Anome and his crew is unknown. I am sending you to meet with a Zion representative, named Alwine. Get any information they have regarding Anome, his ship, his crew; anything that can facilitate his apprehension.

enter.say: Alwine is here. Make sure you get everything they've got!

talk.say:
Hey, {player}. I heard you were going to be here. So you want to know about that bastard Anome, huh?
You can have whatever you want on him, as long as you help bring him down. We're still trying to pinpoint Niobe's location and bring her home, or I'd be right there with you.
Go ahead and check out that computer, and download whatever you want to a disk.

done.say: That computer right over there should have everything we can give you.

objective.text: Get the Disk from the computer

phase.briefing: We need to analyze the data you obtained from Zion. Proceed to one of our science outposts and deliver the disk to Horacio Paprock.

enter.say: Hopefully Horacio Paprock'll be able to turn something up from that data!

objective.text: Give the Disk to Horacio Paprock

talk.say: So... do you have the disk? Give it to me!

done.say: Okay, I'll just run this through. Give me a moment, will you? There, now... hm. Doesn't look too promising. You can take a look for yourself on the computer.
I think it's time to show yourself out.

mission.finish:
This information is not promising. Anome and his crew seem to have disappeared from both the Matrix and the Real. Through our contacts in Zion, we have learned that he has also managed to perform some sort of feat involving the entire floor of the building where Niobe and her associates were assaulted.
The influence of the vials can already be felt. Our task becomes ever more urgent. I will speak with you soon.
